info.title: The plugin features: what a plugin is, read from its format's own words

PLUGIN_FEATURE_AUDIO_EFFECT.description: The CLAP plugin features and LV2 plugin classes that become the descriptor feature audio-effect: every kind of effect, a filter, a dynamics processor, a modulation or a space, and the channel-less roles of a processor (utility, mixing, mastering).
PLUGIN_FEATURE_AUDIO_EFFECT.x-why: The four feature words stay; every CLAP plugin feature and LV2 plugin class is mapped onto them, or onto other, as data (FreeMixer/omx-contract#120). One item per target, so a word is the source term and is named once; a test holds the five items to the terms.

oneOf.title: clapAudioEffect
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature audio-effect: any audio effect with no more specific feature declared.

oneOf.title: clapChorus
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature chorus: an effect that thickens a sound with detuned, delayed copies of it.

oneOf.title: clapCompressor
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature compressor: an effect that narrows a sound's dynamic range.

oneOf.title: clapDeEsser
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature de-esser: an effect that tames sibilance in a voice.

oneOf.title: clapDelay
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature delay: an effect that repeats a sound after a gap.

oneOf.title: clapDistortion
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature distortion: an effect that adds harmonics by overdriving a sound.

oneOf.title: clapEqualizer
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature equalizer: an effect that shapes a sound's frequency balance.

oneOf.title: clapExpander
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature expander: an effect that widens a sound's dynamic range.

oneOf.title: clapFilter
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature filter: an effect that removes or shapes a band of frequencies.

oneOf.title: clapFlanger
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature flanger: an effect that sweeps a short, modulated delay against the dry sound.

oneOf.title: clapFrequencyShifter
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature frequency-shifter: an effect that shifts every frequency of a sound by the same amount.

oneOf.title: clapGate
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature gate: an effect that mutes a sound below a level.

oneOf.title: clapGlitch
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature glitch: an effect that cuts, stutters or corrupts a sound on purpose.

oneOf.title: clapGranular
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature granular: an effect built from short grains of a sound.

oneOf.title: clapLimiter
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature limiter: an effect that holds a sound under a ceiling.

oneOf.title: clapMastering
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature mastering: an effect meant for a mix's final stage.

oneOf.title: clapMixing
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature mixing: an effect meant for use while mixing, such as a channel strip.

oneOf.title: clapMultiEffects
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature multi-effects: several effects combined in one plugin.

oneOf.title: clapPhaseVocoder
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature phase-vocoder: an effect built on a phase vocoder, typically to stretch or shift a sound independently of pitch and time.

oneOf.title: clapPhaser
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature phaser: an effect that sweeps notches through a sound with an all-pass filter chain.

oneOf.title: clapPitchCorrection
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature pitch-correction: an effect that pulls a sound's pitch toward a scale.

oneOf.title: clapPitchShifter
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature pitch-shifter: an effect that changes a sound's pitch without changing its duration.

oneOf.title: clapRestoration
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature restoration: an effect that removes noise, clicks or other damage from a recording.

oneOf.title: clapReverb
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature reverb: an effect that adds the reflections of a space to a sound.

oneOf.title: clapTransientShaper
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature transient-shaper: an effect that reshapes a sound's attack and sustain.

oneOf.title: clapTremolo
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature tremolo: an effect that modulates a sound's level over time.

oneOf.title: clapUtility
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature utility: a plugin that does audio housekeeping rather than a creative effect.

oneOf.title: lv2Allpass
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class AllpassPlugin: an all-pass filter, which shifts phase without changing level.

oneOf.title: lv2Amplifier
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class AmplifierPlugin: a plugin that changes a sound's level.

oneOf.title: lv2Bandpass
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class BandpassPlugin: a filter that passes one band of frequencies.

oneOf.title: lv2Chorus
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ChorusPlugin: an effect that thickens a sound with detuned, delayed copies of it.

oneOf.title: lv2Comb
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class CombPlugin: a comb filter, which adds a short delayed copy of a sound to itself.

oneOf.title: lv2Compressor
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class CompressorPlugin: an effect that narrows a sound's dynamic range.

oneOf.title: lv2Converter
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ConverterPlugin: a plugin that converts a signal from one representation to another.

oneOf.title: lv2Delay
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class DelayPlugin: an effect that repeats a sound after a gap.

oneOf.title: lv2Distortion
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class DistortionPlugin: an effect that adds harmonics by overdriving a sound.

oneOf.title: lv2Dynamics
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class DynamicsPlugin: an effect that changes a sound's dynamic range.

oneOf.title: lv2EQ
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class EQPlugin: an effect that shapes a sound's frequency balance.

oneOf.title: lv2Envelope
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class EnvelopePlugin: a plugin that follows or applies an envelope over time.

oneOf.title: lv2Expander
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ExpanderPlugin: an effect that widens a sound's dynamic range.

oneOf.title: lv2Filter
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class FilterPlugin: an effect that removes or shapes a band of frequencies.

oneOf.title: lv2Flanger
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class FlangerPlugin: an effect that sweeps a short, modulated delay against the dry sound.

oneOf.title: lv2Gate
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class GatePlugin: an effect that mutes a sound below a level.

oneOf.title: lv2Highpass
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class HighpassPlugin: a filter that passes frequencies above a cutoff.

oneOf.title: lv2Limiter
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class LimiterPlugin: an effect that holds a sound under a ceiling.

oneOf.title: lv2Lowpass
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class LowpassPlugin: a filter that passes frequencies below a cutoff.

oneOf.title: lv2Mixer
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class MixerPlugin: a plugin that combines several signals into one.

oneOf.title: lv2Modulator
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ModulatorPlugin: a plugin that modulates one signal with another.

oneOf.title: lv2MultiEQ
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class MultiEQPlugin: a multi-band equaliser.

oneOf.title: lv2ParaEQ
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ParaEQPlugin: a parametric equaliser.

oneOf.title: lv2Phaser
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class PhaserPlugin: an effect that sweeps notches through a sound with an all-pass filter chain.

oneOf.title: lv2Pitch
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class PitchPlugin: a plugin that changes or tracks a sound's pitch.

oneOf.title: lv2Reverb
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ReverbPlugin: an effect that adds the reflections of a space to a sound.

oneOf.title: lv2Simulator
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class SimulatorPlugin: a plugin that models a physical device or space.

oneOf.title: lv2Spatial
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class SpatialPlugin: a plugin that places or moves a sound in space.

oneOf.title: lv2Spectral
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class SpectralPlugin: a plugin that processes a sound in the frequency domain.

oneOf.title: lv2Utility
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class UtilityPlugin: a plugin that does audio housekeeping rather than a creative effect.

oneOf.title: lv2Waveshaper
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class WaveshaperPlugin: a plugin that reshapes a waveform to add harmonics.

PLUGIN_FEATURE_INSTRUMENT.description: The CLAP plugin features and LV2 plugin classes that become the descriptor feature instrument: notes in, audio out.

oneOf.title: clapDrum
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature drum: an instrument that plays drum sounds.

oneOf.title: clapDrumMachine
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature drum-machine: an instrument that sequences and plays drum sounds.

oneOf.title: clapInstrument
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature instrument: a plugin played by notes, with no more specific kind declared.

oneOf.title: clapSampler
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature sampler: an instrument that plays recorded samples.

oneOf.title: clapSynthesizer
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature synthesizer: an instrument that generates its own sound rather than playing samples.

oneOf.title: lv2Instrument
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class InstrumentPlugin: a plugin played by notes.

PLUGIN_FEATURE_NOTE_EFFECT.description: The CLAP plugin features and LV2 plugin classes that become the descriptor feature note-effect: notes in, notes out.

oneOf.title: clapNoteEffect
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature note-effect: a plugin that reads notes and writes notes, such as an arpeggiator.

oneOf.title: lv2MIDI
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class MIDIPlugin: a plugin that processes MIDI, note in to note out.

PLUGIN_FEATURE_ANALYZER.description: The CLAP plugin features and LV2 plugin classes that become the descriptor feature analyzer: audio in, a reading out (a note detector reads pitch from audio).

oneOf.title: clapAnalyzer
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature analyzer: a plugin that reads audio and reports a measurement, with no further output.

oneOf.title: clapNoteDetector
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature note-detector: an analyzer that reads pitch from audio.

oneOf.title: lv2Analyser
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class AnalyserPlugin: a plugin that reads audio and reports a measurement.

PLUGIN_FEATURE_OTHER.description: The CLAP plugin features and LV2 plugin classes that fit none of the four feature words: a channel layout stated as a feature (mono, stereo, surround, ambisonic), and the LV2 classes of a generator, an oscillator, a constant and a function, which take no notes and so are no instrument. A scan carries them in the extension bag.

oneOf.title: clapAmbisonic
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature ambisonic: a plugin declared to work in an ambisonic channel layout.

oneOf.title: clapMono
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature mono: a plugin declared to work in a mono channel layout.

oneOf.title: clapStereo
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature stereo: a plugin declared to work in a stereo channel layout.

oneOf.title: clapSurround
oneOf.x-text: The CLAP plugin feature surround: a plugin declared to work in a surround channel layout.

oneOf.title: lv2Constant
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class ConstantPlugin: a plugin with no input that outputs a constant.

oneOf.title: lv2Function
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class FunctionPlugin: a plugin with no audio input or output, used only for its side effects or parameters.

oneOf.title: lv2Generator
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class GeneratorPlugin: a plugin with no audio input that generates a sound.

oneOf.title: lv2Oscillator
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class OscillatorPlugin: a generator that outputs a periodic waveform.

oneOf.title: lv2Plugin
oneOf.x-text: The LV2 plugin class Plugin: the base LV2 plugin class, with no more specific class declared.
